metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for atomic-cc: verifiable agent workflows as a native Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: atomic
plugins.description: Verifiable agent workflows for Claude Code: schema-validated stages, fresh-context adversarial verification, deterministic quorum reducers, real-command evidence logs, and a gated commit path. Independent port of Atomic (bastani-inc, MIT) — 9 workflows (every upstream builtin), 11 subagents, 12 slash commands, 6 hooks, 537 tests, with upstream drift detection.
